description: Search, read, and create files in one Google Drive folder the operator picks at Connect.
limitations: Google login can see the Drive; the agent is limited to the picked folder. Create and copy are default Off. Official Drive MCP has no delete. Requires a platform-configured OAuth client and the Drive MCP service on that Cloud project. Restricted Drive OAuth scope. Not a Gmail or Calendar connector.
setup_hint: Connect with Google OAuth and pick one folder. Create and copy stay off until the operator enables them.

folder_id.title: Folder
folder_id.description: The one folder every Drive tool is limited to. Search by name or paste a folder link.
